messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild cleaner) and tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑looking, properly tuned instrument looks more appealing to buyers. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | • Use natural light.
• Capture front, back, side, headstock, strings, and any visible wear.
• Include a reference object (coin, ruler). | Clear images reduce buyer hesitation and lower return rates. | | **3. Write a Detailed Description** | • Brand, model, year, wood type, finish, serial number.
• Condition notes (new, like new, used, scratches, repairs).
• Any accessories (case, strap, picks). | Transparency builds trust and reduces disputes. | | **4. Research Pricing** | • Check completed listings on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace.
• Compare similar models, age, and condition. | Helps set a realistic asking price and speeds up sales. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces:** eBay, Reverb, Etsy (for vintage), Amazon (if brand‑new).
• **Local Options:** Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Letgo.
• **Music Stores/Consignment Shops:** Many local shops buy or consign used gear. | Multiple platforms increase exposure; local sites avoid shipping hassles. | | **6. List Your Guitar** | • Upload photos, add description, set price, choose shipping or pickup options.
• For local sites, specify “cash only” or “PayPal” if you prefer. | Proper listing attracts serious buyers. | | **7. Handle Inquiries Promptly** | • Respond within 24 hrs.
• Be honest about any issues. | Good communication leads to quicker deals. | | **8. Negotiate Wisely** | • Decide your lowest acceptable price beforehand.
• Counter offers politely; don’t reveal your bottom line too early. | Keeps negotiations efficient and protects your margin. | | **9. Finalize Payment & Shipping** | • For local sales, meet in a safe public place (police station, coffee shop).
• For online sales, use PayPal Goods & Services or a secure escrow service.
• Ship via USPS Priority Mail or UPS Ground with tracking and insurance. | Protects both parties from fraud. | | **10. Package Securely** | • Wrap strings in a soft cloth.
• Place guitar in a padded case or sturdy cardboard box.
• Add bubble wrap around the body. | Prevents damage during transit. | | **11. Leave Feedback / Review** | • If using a marketplace, leave feedback for the buyer and ask them to do the same. | Builds reputation for future sales. | ### Quick Tips * **Timing:** Listings posted mid‑week tend to get more views than weekend posts. * **Price Flexibility:** If you’re not in a hurry, consider listing at a slightly higher price to allow room for negotiation. * **Safety First:** Always meet in a public place for local transactions and verify payment before handing over the instrument. Good luck with your sale! If you have any specific questions—like how to handle a particular platform or what to do if a buyer wants a discount—just let me know.
